bloxfruits.name: Blox Fruits
howTo: Tap the Settings button (gear icon) on the left side of the screen.
On the Settings menu, look for the Redeem DLC Code section and click Redeem .
Copy and paste a working code from our list into the box and press Redeem .

animevanguards.name: Anime Vanguards
howTo: Tap the Profile button on the right side of the screen.
Tap the Codes button to the left of the profile screen.
Copy and paste a code from our list into the codes box and press Redeem.

fisch.name: Fisch
howTo: Open Roblox Fisch on your device.
Press M to open the in-game Menu.
Scroll down to the Codes section.
Input a working Code in the codes box.
Press Enter to claim the reward associated with the code.

volleyballlegends.name: Volleyball Legends
howTo: Open {{game_name}} on Roblox.
Tap the Shop button on the bottom of the screen.
Navigate to the Codes section int he Shop.
Enter a Working Code in the codes box.
Press Use Code to redeem the reward.

nights99.name: 99 Nights in the Forest
howTo: Launch {{game_name}} on Roblox.
Walk over to the Currency Shop NPC and open the shop.
Tap the Codes button inside the shop.
Paste a working code into the box and tap Submit .
Enjoy your free rewards!

dresstoimpress.name: Dress to Impress
howTo: Open Dress to Impress on Roblox.
Tap the Codes button on the left side of the screen.
Paste a working code into the box.
Press Redeem to claim the reward.

bluelock.name: Blue Lock Rivals
howTo: Join the Group and like the game on Roblox.
Open Blue Lock Rivals on Roblox.
Enter the Lobby and click the Codes button.
Enter a working Code in the box and tap Redeem .

basketballzero.name: Basketball Zero
howTo: Launch {{game_name}} on Roblox.
Tap the Codes button at the bottom of the screen.
Paste a code from our list (or type it) into the codes box.
Press Redeem to claim the reward.

jujutsu-shenanigans.name: Jujutsu Shenanigans
howTo: Open Jujutsu Shenanigans on Roblox.
Tap the Shop button by clicking on your money at the top of the screen.
Navigate to the Rewards tab.
Paste a working code into the box.
Press Redeem to claim the reward.

100-days-at-sea.name: 100 Days At Sea
howTo: Launch {{game_name}} on Roblox
Tap the Codes button at the top of the screen
Copy and paste a verified working code from our code list into the box
Press the Submit button to claim the reward

survive-zombie-arena.name: Survive Zombie Arena
howTo: Press the Shop button to open the in-game shop.
Scroll down to the Codes section.
Copy and paste a working code from our list.
Press Redeem to claim the reward.

bee-swarm-simulator.name: Bee Swarm Simulator
howTo: Tap the settings button (gear icon) on the top left.
Find the Promo Codes section at the top of the settings menu.
Copy and paste a working code into the text box.
Press Redeem to claim the reward associated with the code.

mine-a-planet.name: Mine a Planet
howTo: Launch {{game_name}} on Roblox
Tap the Settings icon (cogwheel) found at the top right corner
Copy and paste a verified working code into the code box
Press Redeem to claim the reward
